statement: Initialize AMO as a model-independent organization with repository-based continuity and confirmed G-001 human amendment approval.
context: The human founder supplied the foundation specification. This records the instruction, not approval of generated drafts or enrollment of an approver.
alternatives: Vendor memory as authority: explicitly excluded by the founder.
Autonomous runtime now: explicitly excluded by the founder.
risks: The source summary is not a cryptographically authenticated transcript.
Git history can be rewritten by privileged administrators.
assumptions: No ultimate mission or legal/business model was supplied.
expected_outcome: A portable, auditable foundation with G-001 recorded and a clearly draft constitution.

authorization.basis: Explicit human founding request; scoped summary retained in governance/founder_brief.md. No reusable approval mandate is inferred.
